Dynamic Fullbright
 
 
 

Traditional fullbright mods apply a nightvision filter, set the light levels all to the maximum, or change the gamma.

Dynamic Fullbright instead offers the ability to clamp or scale light levels, retaining the lighting ambience of the area while still making things visible. 
You can set everything to the maximum to achieve true full brightness, or tone it down to suit your preference.

 Example
Dynamic Fullbright works by taking the lightlevels obtained by the render thread and shifting them during lighting updates.
 

The default settings scale block and sky light levels to be in the range of 4-15.

 Extras
With cloth config and mod menu, you access the settings to bring the brightness to anything you desire.

 About

 TLDR 

 This mod fixes high allocation rates in some MCreator mods that use a lot of player-attached variables.
 This might result in less GC stuttering, less average/peak memory usage, and even a small FPS gain. 
 Your mileage may vary, and it entirely depends on your installed MCreator mods.
 There shouldn't be any downsides to having this mod installed.
 This mod will detect all applicable mods when you launch the game, 
but it will not come into effect until you launch the game again.

A simple Fabric mod that makes villagers follow players holding emerald-related items including

This mod instead makes use of a proper brain task to add following behaviour,

This mod adds a Config File to control the version of your modpack and prevent connection to servers with the wrong Modpack Version.

How to use:
 1. Find your modpacks Config Folder.
 2. Open the config file called nmpvc-common.toml in your favorite text editor.
 3. Change the version number "1.0.0" in modpack-versions = "1.0.0" to whatever version your modpack is.
 4. Save the file. 
 5. Make sure you include this mod in your modpack both client and server.
 6. Remember to do this EVERY TIME you change your modpack version.

shared-resources:
Shared Resources

A mod for easily sharing game files between separate Minecraft instances. 
Best used with a multi-instance launcher like MultiMC or Prism Launcher.

It works by selecting a global directory to hold your common game files, 
and modifying Minecraft to use that directory instead of the default one.
Where possible, the mod tries to load files from the global directory together 
with the local ones, merging the two and allowing you to select from both. 
This is currently only available for resource packs, data packs and shaders.

Currently supported game files/directories:
- Resource packs
- Data packs
- Saves
- Vanilla options (video settings, controls, etc.)
- Servers
- Screenshots
- Saved Hotbars
- The fabric config folder (should work with the configs of any properly coded mods)
- Shader packs (via Iris)
- Schematics (via Litematica)
- Replay Recordings (via ReplayMod)

Melodify

 

Displays your current Spotify playback directly in Minecraft.

Melodify adds a small, customizable HUD that shows what you’re listening to, so you don’t have to alt-tab while playing.

 TL;DR
- Shows your current Spotify track in-game 
- Lyrics when available 
- Playback controls 
- HUD is customizable 

 What it shows

- Song title, artist, and album artwork 
- A progress bar with timestamps 
- Synced lyrics (when available) 
- Basic playback controls (play/pause, next, previous) 

 Customization

You can move the HUD to any corner, scale it, adjust opacity, and change how the progress bar looks. 
Accent colors are automatically pulled from the album artwork.

There’s also a compact mode if you want something more subtle, and the HUD hides itself while you’re in menus.

 

 Setup

This is primarily useful for mod developers and pack makers, but can also be used by players to modify their own packs.

 V2 Disclaimer
JsonPatcher v2 is currently in beta. V2 introduces a bunch of new features including global patches for mods and modpacks.
Documentation for v2 is available at jsonpatcher-docs.mattidragon.dev.
The documentation is however quite incomplete and partially outdated. 
For some cases it might be best to consult the old wiki instead.

 Usage
 
 Gradle dependency (for mod developers)

 groovy
repositories {
 maven {
 url 'https://jitpack.io'
 }
}

dependencies {
 modImplementation(include("com.github.mattidragon:jsonpatcher:${jsonpatcher version}"))

Cast — Right click to throw the bobber, it sits for a second, then fires and breaks. Looks clean.

water-walking-fix:
Water Walking Fix

 What this mod is
In vanilla, the only sources of an entity being able to walk on fluid is the Strider, which is able to walk on lava.
Vanilla's implementation however is theoretically general, with a method on entities which can be overridden to allow the entity to walk on any fluid.

Mods exist which use this method, for example to allow players to walk on water, e.g. with a new enchantment or by picking a specific origin.

Because vanilla's implementation doesn't consider walking on water as a possibility, the following bugs exist:
 Entities which can walk on a fluid are only able to walk on source blocks, not flowing instances of the fluid
 Entities which can walk on a fluid are not able to walk on fluidlogged blocks

This mod fixes those two issues. Despite the name, the mod is generalized to all fluids, not just water.

 What this mod is not

The mod does not add

explosion-proof-chests:
Explosion-Proof Chests
This is an incredibly basic mod that makes all block entities (that is, blocks that store data like items) unable to be blown up.

This mod has been tested on 1.18.2-1.21.8. It likely works on lower versions but may need to be recompiled with a lower mixin Java compatibility version. I have no interest in supporting ancient versions, however.

This mod is good for SMPs where you don't want people stealing other people's items - I made it specifically to go alongside Hey That's Mine, since it only prevents players from opening chests, not other forms of theft.

Search terms: explosions, blowing up, chests, containers, items, immunity, unbreakable, blast resistance.

frex:
FREX is a rendering API for Minecraft mods to create content that wouldn't normally be possible. 

FREX is currently only available for Fabric but a Forge version is planned. 

FREX includes a built-in renderer (Pastel) that implements most of its features (except shaders) but it's possible to create a mod with a different/better implementation. Canvas is currently the only renderer that implements FREX. 

Renderers and mods that use FREX (like JMX) will generally include it so you probably don't need to download and install it separately. It's listed here only for visibility.

no-more-structures-essential:
THESE MODS ARE NOW UNSUPPORTED, I WILL NOT BE UPDATING THEM ANYMORE

 Why
Part of early Minecraft's charm was the emptiness and loneliness of the world, the lack of structures making it feel isolated, yet more free and personal, as you stood on an untouched land.

 Mod's features
This mod tries to achieve this feel by removing all the non-essential structures, which means anything required to beat the game (Nether Fortresses and Strongholds) are still kept, the End City still included as the Elytra is still a game changing item unobtainable elsewhere.

 Supports 1.18.2 - 1.21 

 Notice
I will not be backporting to versions earlier than 1.18.2, as removing structures prior to that version is alot more difficult.

worldgamerules:
WorldGameRules
A fabric mod to change all gamerules to be separate per world

 Commands
The vanilla gamerule command has been replaced with a custom command that requires a dimension.
The gamerule command requires world-gamerules.commands.gamerule or operator level 2.

- /gamerule [dimension selector] - Query the gamerule in all specified dimensions
- /gamerule [dimension selector] - Set the gamerule to in all specified dimensions

 Dimension selectors
Dimension selectors allow you to specify what dimensions should be queried / set
- @all - Selects all dimensions
- @namespace - Selects dimensions with the specified namespace (eg. namespace minecraft selects minecraft:overworld , minecraft:the nether and minecraft:the end , but not custom:dimension )
- @regex - Selects all dimensions, where the dimension id matches the regex
- - To select a specific dimension

Functionality

Freecam mods allow players to move the camera independently from the player body. This is useful for screenshots, building, and administration, but it can be problematic on servers when players use it to look into or move through areas that are normally limited by block collisions.

AntiFreecam evolved addresses that specific behavior:

The server registers a custom configuration payload.
During connection setup, the server requires the client to have this AntiFreecam mod installed.
The server sends the client the setting forceCollision=true.
The client stores this server setting for the current connection.
If the Freecam mod is installed, a mixin hooks into its configuration.
Block collisions then remain active in Freecam, even when Freecam would normally disable them.

Control Engineering is an addon for Immersive Engineering focusing on redstone control and automation. Its main
features are control panels and logic cabinets.

 Control panels offer a compact way to control and monitor various redstone signals using various different
components like buttons, variacs, panel meters and many more. Panel designs are stored on Punched Tape and then
created using the Control Panel CNC . This allows existing designs to easily be replicated and modified. The tape
designs can either be written out manually using a Keypunch or created in the visual interface of the Panel
Designer .

 Logic cabinets are an independent take on redstone logic in IEs visual style. Unlike the logic units added by IE, these
support analog signals, but also require power to keep them running.

Features
- Timer — Displays exactly how long you've been holding block in milliseconds
- Durability Display — Color-coded shield health so you know when it's about to break

- Blocks Counter — Tracks total attacks blocked this session
- Enemy Shields

- Configuration
- All features can be toggled individually through Mod Menu. The HUD position is fully customizable with a drag-and-drop editor—just click "Edit HUD Position" in settings and drag it wherever you want.

- Fabric API
- YACL 3.x
- Mod Menu (recommended)

fffoodspoilageandpreservation:
FFFoodSpoilageAndPreservation

Want spoiling food AND ways to keep it fresh? Look no further! Every food slowly goes from Fresh to Rotten, and it's up to you to preserve it by smoking, drying, curing and keeping a nice cold cellar. It adds no new blocks or items, and it works with modded food too.

 
(this is the more info when holding shift)

 How it works

- Food moves through five stages: Fresh, Good, Stale, Rotting and Rotten . Each stage fills you up a little less, and fully spoiled food turns into rotten flesh.
- Where you keep food matters. An ender chest stops spoilage, and barrels, pots and bundles slow it down.
- Cold slows spoilage and heat speeds it up. Leave food somewhere cold long enough and it freezes (let it thaw before eating!).
- Preserve food to slow it down: Cured (craft with bone meal), Brined (craft with an awkward potion), Candied (craft with a honey bottle), Drie

Realism Tweaks 

 Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge 

---

 Realism Tweaks is a lightweight, self-contained collection of small physics and survival tweaks that make the world behave a little more believably. Every feature is independent and fully configurable, so you can enable only the ones you want and tune the rest to taste.

 Features

 Heavy Objects
Anvils crush soft blocks (torches, flowers, grass and the like) directly beneath them when placed or while falling. Optionally, falling sand, gravel and concrete powder do the same - and can injure entities they land on, dealing damage that scales with the distance fallen.

 Water Impact
Diving into water no longer makes you invincible. A long fall still hurts, but deeper water cushions the blow - shallow water barely helps, while a proper pool keeps you safe. When a belly flop turns fatal, you get a fittingly humorous death message.

Tom's Livestock Overhaul
Ever felt like your farm was a little too... simple? Tom's Livestock Overhaul brings real genetics and natural behavior to Minecraft's farm animals. Sheep, Cows, Pigs, and Chickens now carry inheritable genetic traits that determine their appearance, spawn according to the climate they live in, need actual space to graze, and look out for each other when danger's nearby.

 Genetic Traits & Breeding

 

Every Sheep, Cow, Pig, Chicken, and Wolf spawns with a genuine two-allele genotype under the hood — one allele from each "parent" — following real Punnett-square inheritance. Clear the current destination. ElytraPilot will fly you in the direction you are looking.

Chat bubbles that show what a player is typing above their head in real time and stay around for a few seconds when the message is sent.

Rendering is server-side with vanilla text display entities. Install only needs to be serverside for rendering, for typing in real time you need the client install too.

 Privacy

What you're typing reaches the server before you press enter. Opt-outs:

- config/coh/client.json : "enabled": false disables all transmission.
- Messages starting with -- hide , // hide or hide are never sent.
- Commands are never sent.
- config/coh/server.json : "enabled": false disables the feature server-wide.

 Server config ( config/coh/server.json )

 Key Default Meaning 
 ---------------------- --------- ------------------------------------------------ 
 enabled true Master switch 
 viewRange 0.5 Visibility range (about 32 blocks) 
 throttleMs 1
ryus-timer:
Ryu's Timer

A simple on-screen timer for Fabric. I made it for challenge videos and speedruns, where you want a timer that looks good on screen and doesn't reset every time you close the game.

Every world and every server has its own timer. You can leave, play somewhere else, close Minecraft, and when you come back the time is still there.

 What it can do

- Shows the time as 42s , 12m 4s , 2h 14m 9s or 3d 4h 12m 9s , with optional milliseconds
- Saves the timer per world and per server, also when the game closes
- You choose when it counts: always (real time, keeps going while you're offline), only while you're in the world, or only while you're actually playing (stops in the pause menu)
- Drag it anywhere on the screen with the mouse ( /timer edit ), or use one of 9 fixed positions
- Any size, from small to really big
- 28 color presets, including gradients like Fire, Ocean, Aurora

friendcode:
This mod adds friend codes to Minecraft, which are an easy way to play in the same world with remote friends. They can be created by selecting "Open To...", which replaces "Open To LAN", and selecting the "Friend Code" submenu. They can be connected to through "Multiplayer" - "Direct Connect", which also gets a "Friend Code" submenu.

The mod is not strictly required on either end, as you can also set up the connections through the i2p router directly. It just makes things more convenient, supporting persistent codes tied to the world, as well as ephemeral codes tied to the play session. (World codes will not persist across different computers, however.)

selective-keep-inventory:
Selective Keep Inventory

Selective Keep Inventory is a lightweight vanilla datapack for Minecraft Java Edition that enables keep inventory for specific players only.

Instead of enabling keepInventory for the entire world, this pack lets you choose exactly which players keep their items and XP after death.

 Features

- Per-player keep inventory
- Per-player XP retention
- Fully server-side
- Vanilla datapack, no plugin or mod required
- Supports Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.2 to 1.21.11

 How it works

Players with the keepinv tag keep their inventory and XP on death.

Players without the tag die normally and lose their inventory/XP as expected.

 Commands

Enable for a player:
 /tag add keepinv 

Disable for a player:
 /tag remove keepinv 

Example:
 /tag Steve add keepinv

soxy:
Soxy

Soxy is a simple server-side helper mod for Voxy that generates .voxy cache data directly from the server world.

 Why Soxy?
Currently, many server-side voxy LoD distribution mods suffer from various bugs, and some are just "AI Slop". Other alternatives either consume excessive network bandwidth or fail to properly update modified chunks. Soxy solves this by providing a straightforward way to prepare the cache on the server, saving clients from having to import region files manually.

 Features
 No Server-side Sodium Required: Soxy removes Voxy's dependency on Sodium for the dedicated server. You only need to install Soxy and Voxy on your server.
 Easy Distribution: The generated .voxy files can be efficiently distributed to players via a file server or CDN, or automatically synchronized using mods like automodpack . 
 Recommended Workflow: Periodically run /soxy generate via a sch

This is an unofficial backport of LazyDFU for Legacy Fabric, specifically Minecraft versions 1.13.x

LazyDFU is an optimization mod for Minecraft that defers unnecessary initialization work so that it is only performed if required. Specifically, it makes the initialization of DataFixerUpper "lazy" - that is, it will not immediately create the rules required to migrate data from older versions of Minecraft to newer versions until it actually needs to do so.

The code of this backport is the same as LazyDFU 0.1.2, adjusted to legacy mappings.

For more information about how LazyDFU works, check out the official LazyDFU modrinth page, containing the 1.14+ releases, also consider supporting astei, the original creator of LazyDFU!

Use copper ingots to craft tools and armor.

 Copper Tools
Copper tools are faster than iron, but lose durability quickly.

The tool will oxidize as it's used. As the oxidization builds up, it will get slower but more durable.

Unoxidized tools lose 4 durability each time they're used. A fully oxidized tool loses only 1 durability.

 

 Oxidization Poison

Oxidized tools have a small chance of poisoning any mob they hit.

 

 Scraping

Right-click on a grindstone to scrape oxidization off of a tool and repair it.

This will also erode some of the tool's max durability, making it weaker over time.

Or repair with an axe in an anvil.

 

 Copper Armor

Copper armor will oxidize as it takes damage.

When hit by an axe, there is a chance the armor will be repaired.

uncam-render-distance:
Raises Minecraft’s render distance limit from 32 chunks to 512. 

Vanilla caps the client-side render-distance slider at 32 chunks (or 16 on low-RAM installations). Sodium uses the same limit, hardcoding its slider range to setRange(2, 32) .

The server has a separate limit as well: ChunkMap.setServerViewDistance() clamps the configured view distance with Mth.clamp(viewDistance, 2, 32) . This means that even if you manually set a higher value in options.txt , the integrated or dedicated server will still only send up to 32 chunks.

This mod removes all three limits:

 Raises the vanilla Options.renderDistance IntRange maximum to 512 
 Raises Sodium’s render-distance slider maximum to 512 
 Raises the ChunkMap server view-distance clamp to 512

beelightful:
Beelightful intends to make bee stings more realistic.

In vanilla Minecraft, when a bee stings you, you have the same effect - you lose two to three hearts depending on your difficulty and get the poison effect for a certain amount of time.

With this mod, however, when a bee stings you, the effect changes based on your world's seed and your UUID. Therefore, you will always have the same effect in the same world with the same seed, but the effect will only change if you start a new save or if you change accounts. Just like in real life, your allergic effect to bee stings does not change.

There's a chance that you will get any of the following effects:
- Only hearts lost, no poison
- Only poison, no hearts lost
- Shorter poison length than usual
- Normal effect
- Longer poison length than usual
- Longer poison length than usual plus double hearts lost
- Allergy resulting in an instant f

In vanilla Minecraft, you can add entries to the enchantment power provider tag to make them provide power to enchanting tables like bookshelves do (in fact, bookshelves themselves are part of this tag by default). However, this power boost is hard coded to 1 (the same as bookshelves), and it doesn't respect block states, making it inconvenient for certain block types (like candles, which can contain multiple candles in one block space). Arcane offers a solution by adding data driven enchanting power providers , which can be much more flexible in their parameters.

 Installation

Drop ttyclient- .jar alongside Fabric API and Kotlin for Fabric into your mods/ folder. On first launch, TTYClient creates its config directory at ~/TTYClient/ .

 Usage

Type ; followed by a command in chat. Commands are intercepted client-side and never sent to the server .

;help (alias: ?) lis

- Drag the datapack file into the datapacks folder.

Despite its medieval roots, it's versatile enough to support a range of themes including Steampunk, Ancient Roman, and Oriental styles.

- 32x32 hand-crafted textures
- Custom 3d models
- Connected texture support
- Biome-specific textures
- Rename things with nametags or the anvil to give them a new look and custom texture. This works for:
 - Armors
 - Shields
 - Pain

I've always loved the vanilla textures of Minecraft. However, I always thought it would be cool if certain repetitive items had unique textures, with potions being one of these items. So I set out to make a unique texture for every potion in the game while attempting to emulate the vanilla art style. I hope that you enjoy using this pack as much as I’ve enjoyed making it.

 

 Identification
I attempted to make a predictable and understandable pattern for how the potion textures evolve depending on their ingredients. All potions now have a unique texture, with their variants displaying small changes depending on their length, power, or bottle type. Potions diluted with redstone are longer and appear in a larger bottle. On the other hand, glowstone makes the potion more potent and concentrated, allowing for a smaller bottle also distinguishable with a golden band.

blockley:
Blockley 🚀

 Blockley is a Minecraft resource pack that transforms the game by turning every single pixel into a block .

Every pixel on a texture becomes the texture of an in-game block. Instead of pixels being flat image data, each one is represented as its own block, creating a true one-to-one relationship between pixels and blocks.

Because of this, Blockley effectively functions as a high-resolution 256×256 resource pack , with detail emerging from geometry rather than traditional texture resolution.

The result is a highly detailed, hyper-voxelized world where familiar textures are reconstructed at a new scale. Small visual details turn into large structures, and surfaces gain depth and physical presence while remaining consistent with the original textures.

 Features
- Every pixel is turned into the texture of an in-game block
- One-to-one pixel-to-block mapping
- Effective 256×

布洛克利🚀 Blockley是一个Minecraft资源包，通过将每个像素变成一个方块来改变游戏。 材质上的每个像素都成为游戏中方块的材质。像素不是平面图像数据，而是每个像素都表示为自己的方块，在像素和方块之间创建真正的一对一关系。 正因为如此，Blockley有效地作为一个高分辨率256×256资源包，细节来自几何而不是传统的材质分辨率。 其结果是一个高度细节化的超体素化世界，熟悉的材质以新的比例重建。小的视觉细节变成大的结构，表面获得深度和物理存在，同时保持与原始材质的一致性。 特征 - 每一个像素都变成了游戏中方块的材质 - 一对一像素到方块映射 - 有效256×

cursed-textures-by-drblittz:
Cursed Resources is a Minecraft texture pack designed to make your game look as weird, ridiculous, and hilariously cursed as possible. This pack isn't meant to be scary or creepy—instead, it focuses on turning ordinary Minecraft textures into strange, goofy, and completely unnecessary creations that make every moment feel slightly wrong in the best way possible.
